name: Spiking DeltaNet
summary: DeltaNet with every projection replaced by a spiking linear; the delta-rule state is written with a sigmoid strength β.

name: Spiking S4
summary: An S4D long convolution whose output is divided by a learnable threshold, spiked, and mixed by a non-spiking Conv1×1 + GLU.

name: Spiking RetNet
summary: RetNet retention with a fixed per-head decay γ and a SiLU output gate; every projection spikes.

name: Spiking LightNet
summary: An element-wise linear recurrence with a data-dependent decay; every projection spikes.

name: Spiking GLA
summary: Gated linear attention with a per-head scalar decay; the spiking q/k/v/g projections share one SiLU ShortConv.

name: Spiking HGRN
summary: An element-wise gated recurrence h = σ(f)⊙h + SiLU(i) driven by two spiking projections.

name: Spiking HGRN2
summary: HGRN with a short causal convolution on each of its two spiking projections.

name: Spiking RWKV-6
summary: RWKV-6 time mixing with a static token shift, spiking projections, a data-dependent per-channel decay and a bonus u for the current token.

name: Spiking RWKV-7
summary: RWKV-7-style time mixing with spiking projections, a per-channel decay and an input-side removal term v − k⊙a.

name: Spiking ABC
summary: Two decay-free linear-attention passes over 64 memory slots, fed by spiking q/k/v/slot projections.

name: Spiking GSA
summary: Spiking gated slot memory: softmax-addressed slots with a per-slot forget gate and a SiLU output gate.

name: Spiking DeltaFormer
summary: Spiking delta-rule memory with a per-head decay and a SiLU output gate; all projections are SpikingLinears.

name: Spiking Gated DeltaNet
summary: Spiking gated delta rule: a per-head decay α and write strength β, with SiLU + L2-normalised spiking q, k.

name: Spiking KDA
summary: Spiking delta rule with a per-head decay, a write strength β and an input gate α on the values.

name: Spiking DeltaProduct
summary: Spiking gated delta rule (one Householder step per token) with ShortConvs and a SiLU output gate.

name: Spiking Mamba
summary: Spiking Mamba: spiking in-, x- and dt-projections drive a diagonal selective scan, gated by SiLU(z).

name: Spiking Mamba2
summary: Spiking Mamba2: one spiking in-projection feeds an SSD scan with scalar per-head decay, gated by SiLU(z).

name: Spiking MesaNet
summary: Spiking test-time-training memory: a decayed delta-rule step with learning rate η, read out before the write.

name: Spiking Comba
summary: Spiking gated linear attention whose decay gets a feedback term from the normalised state, with a norm cap on the state.

name: Spiking MetaLA
summary: Spiking key-free linear attention: the key is 1 − decay, plus a self-augmentation term and a SiLU output gate.

name: Spike-output KDA
summary: The expert spiking KDA block, with the GELU removed from the MLP and the block output re-normalised and re-projected through a spiking linear.

name: Channel-gated KDA
summary: The KDA write strength β and input gate α become per-channel vectors from wider spiking projections, and the MLP drops its GELU.

name: SAFM MesaNet
summary: After each residual add the whole stream is rescaled by a spiking self-gate, a second spiking feature modulator sits before the MLP, and the MLP becomes a spiking GLU.

name: Spiking-MLP Comba
summary: Functionally the Spiking Comba expert: the spiking MLP is made mandatory and nothing new is added.

name: Dynamic Potential Threshold
summary: One learnable per-channel block threshold divides every branch input before it is spiked; the S4D output is gated by binary spikes and the FFN multiplies two spike trains.

name: Contextual-gate HGRN
summary: Spiking context, reset and decay-gain projections modulate the HGRN forget and input gates; both sub-layer outputs pass through spike-driven residual gates.

name: Adaptive-gated HGRN
summary: Per-head spiking modulators rescale the HGRN decay and input, a gated spiking MLP adds a spiking local conv, and the block output is re-projected through a spiking linear.

name: Dual-Gating KDA
summary: Spiking input and output gates wrap both sub-layers, β/α of the KDA become per-channel, and the MLP becomes a spiking GLU.

name: Adaptive Local-gate HGRN
summary: Conv-smoothed spiking modulators rescale HGRN decay and input, a third spiking modulator gates the recurrent output, and the MLP and block output gain extra spiking projections.

name: Dual Residual-Gated MesaNet
summary: Each plain residual add becomes a GRU-like mix x⊙(1−f) + y⊙u, with f and u from two spiking gates reading a short convolution of x + y.

name: Output-Gated Scaler MesaNet
summary: Residual adds become x⊙f + y⊙u with two spiking gates on a short convolution of x + y, and a spiking scaler gates the whole block output.

name: Multi-modulator HGRN
summary: Four conv-smoothed spiking modulators scale HGRN decay (twice), input and output; the gated MLP adds a spiking gate on its local conv, and the block output is re-projected through a spiking linear.

name: Dual-Gated Residual KDA
summary: Both residual adds become spiking forget/add gates driven by a short-conv context of x + branch; KDA β/α are per-channel and the MLP is a normalised spiking GLU.

name: Split-Context Gated MesaNet
summary: Residual adds become x⊙(1−f) + y⊙u, where u is read from the branch y and f from the stream x, each through its own short convolution and spiking gate; the MLP gains an inner residual layer.

name: Gated Spike-Residual MesaNet
summary: Each residual add becomes x⊙(1−f) + y⊙u; x + y is first re-encoded by a spiking projection, then a short convolution feeds the two spiking gates f and u.

name: Proj-Norm Gated MesaNet
summary: Residual adds become x⊙(1−f) + y⊙u with spiking gates, and every MesaNet input projection (q, k, v, η, γ) is RMS-normalised right after its spiking linear.

name: Spiking DeltaNet (clean-up)
summary: Same block as Spiking DeltaNet; the evolution only fixed the spike bookkeeping so the MLP's fc1/fc2 spikes are now counted.

name: Spiking-MLP GLA
summary: The expert Spiking GLA block with the MLP's GELU replaced by a LIF neuron, so fc2 receives spike trains.

name: Dual-gated Spiking GSA
summary: A spiking feature gate modulates the GSA input, and both residual adds become x⊙(1−f) + b⊙a with forget and add gates from spiking projections of short convolutions.

name: Spike-dropout MLP DeltaNet
summary: An extra LIF layer spikes fc1's output and dropout is applied to those binary spikes before fc2 re-spikes them; all three MLP spike trains are counted.

name: GELU-MLP DeltaNet
summary: Spiking DeltaNet whose MLP inserts an analog GELU between fc1 and fc2; fc2's neurons spike on the GELU output.

name: Hidden-spike MLP DeltaNet
summary: An extra LIF layer spikes fc1's output after dropout, so fc2 receives a binary hidden spike train; these spikes replace fc2's own in the spike count.

name: Spike-inhibited GLA
summary: Binary q/k/v spikes feed the GLA state and the MLP hidden layer spikes; each residual branch is passed only where a gate neuron fires and an inhibition neuron stays silent, which as coded is never.

name: SGRF MesaNet
summary: Spiking Gated Recurrent Fusion: each residual add becomes x⊙f + y⊙u, with forget and input gates fired by the concatenated short convolutions of x and y.

name: Simplified-MLP Comba
summary: The GELU between the two spiking MLP layers is removed, so fc2's neuron fires directly on fc1's analog output.

name: Mesa Spike-Gated
summary: Per-token spike counts of q, k, v steer the TTT learning rate and decay and gate the attention output; each residual branch is gated with its own spike rate, and a spiking projection replaces the identity output.

name: Spike-input DeltaProduct
summary: Extra LIF neurons after the short convolutions turn q, k and v into binary spike trains before they enter the gated delta-rule state.

name: Binary-gated DeltaNet
summary: ShortConvs are dropped and each sub-layer output is masked by binary spikes fired from the residual stream before it is added back.

name: Key-rate β GELU DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the key spike train rescales the delta-rule write strength β, the MLP gains an analog GELU, and q, k get a second SiLU.

name: Spiked-GELU Comba
summary: An extra spiking neuron turns the GELU output of fc1 into spikes before fc2, which then re-spikes them.

name: Spiking DeltaNet (refactor)
summary: Functionally the expert Spiking DeltaNet: an earlier spike-rate β modulator and GELU were removed again, leaving only refactored activation code.

name: GELU-free Spiking KDA
summary: The expert spiking KDA block with the GELU removed between the two spiking MLP layers, so fc1's raw current drives fc2's neuron.

name: Lean Key-rate GELU DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the key spike train rescales the delta-rule write strength β and the MLP gains an analog GELU; q and k keep a single SiLU.

name: Spike-encoded Comba
summary: Standalone neurons spike every linear-layer input (block inputs, o proj, fc2), and the decay feedback net becomes spiking.

name: HomeoResSSM
summary: Each sub-layer output is scaled by a tiny spiking gate driven by that sub-layer's own mean spike rate.

name: Adaptive DPT
summary: A channel-mean activity signal shifts one shared threshold that divides every branch input; FFN branches get their own offsets, and residuals become spike forget/update gates.

name: Deep-Spiking MLP LightNet
summary: Expert spiking LightNet mixer; in the MLP the GELU is replaced by an explicit LIF neuron, so fc2 receives (dropped-out) binary spikes.

name: Mamba2 Hybrid-Gated
summary: Spiking Mamba2 whose SSD runs on binary q/k/v spike tensors with a binary z gate; spike rates drive sigmoid gates on both branch outputs and on the FFN activation.

name: Rate-gated Residual DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate rescales the delta-rule β, and each sub-layer output is gated by a spiking linear driven by its own mean spike rate.

name: GELU-free Key-rate DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the key spike train, passed through a tiny spiking linear, rescales the delta-rule write strength β; the MLP stays GELU-free and q, k get a second SiLU.

name: Gated-MLP Comba
summary: A parallel spiking gate projection σ-gates the GELU branch of the MLP before fc2.

name: State-Adaptive KDA
summary: β, decay and α come from one fused spiking projection plus an offset that a spiking layer derives from the normalised carried-in state (zero without a cache, so in training only its bias acts).

name: Spike-gated MLP LightNet
summary: Expert spiking LightNet mixer; the MLP's GELU output is multiplied by binary spikes that a LIF layer emits from that same output.

name: Adaptive-dt Mamba2
summary: HomeoResSSM-style spike-rate residual gates, plus a per-token decay offset that the in-projection's firing rate sets through a tiny spiking projection.

name: Spike-driven Residual Gating
summary: The mixer output is scaled by σ of a spiking linear driven by the pooled firing rate of all mixer spike trains, on top of key-rate β modulation; the MLP gains an analog GELU.

name: Summed-rate Loss DeltaNet
summary: The expert spiking DeltaNet block, trained with an extra loss of 0.01 × the sum of the mean firing rates of its seven spike trains.

name: GELU-MLP DeltaNet (refactor)
summary: Spiking DeltaNet whose MLP inserts an analog GELU between fc1 and fc2; functionally the same block as GELU-MLP DeltaNet (i02-s0273), reached again with refactored code.

name: Dual-gate Comba
summary: Two extra spiking projections add to and rescale the decay logit; neurons spike every linear input and the feedback net.

name: Lean Key-rate DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the key spike train, passed through a tiny spiking linear, rescales the delta-rule write strength β; q, k keep a single SiLU and all dropout is removed.

name: QKV-rate β DeltaNet
summary: The pooled mean firing rate of the q, k and v spike trains, passed through a tiny spiking linear, rescales the delta-rule write strength β; q, k also get a second SiLU.

name: Pooled-rate Loss DeltaNet
summary: The expert spiking DeltaNet block, trained with an extra loss of 0.01 × the mean firing rate of all its spikes pooled into one vector.

name: Firing-rate Gain DeltaNet
summary: Each sub-layer output is multiplied by 1 + the mean firing rate of the spikes feeding its last projection.

name: Key-rate Sigmoid-β DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the key spike train, passed through a tiny spiking linear, rescales the delta-rule write strength β by a sigmoid gain in (0, 2).

name: Key-rate β DeltaNet + Dropout
summary: The mean firing rate of the k-projection spikes, passed through a tiny spiking linear, rescales the delta-rule write strength β; otherwise the expert block, dropout included.

name: Linear-conv DeltaNet
summary: The SiLU inside the q/k/v short convolutions is removed, leaving the projection neurons as the only non-linearity.

name: Spike-gated dt Mamba2
summary: Spiking Mamba2 whose dt is multiplied by a sigmoid gate driven by the in-projection's spike rate, with scalar spike-rate gates on both residual branches.

name: GELU-free HomeoResSSM
summary: HomeoResSSM with every GELU removed (in the MLP and inside the residual-gate MLP), so the spiking neurons are the only nonlinearity.

name: Out-rate-gated DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate rescales β, the rate of the spikes entering o proj gates the token-mixer output, and an analog GELU sits between the MLP layers.

name: Spike-fed DeltaNet
summary: Extra LIF neurons after activation-free short convolutions feed binary q/k/v spikes into the delta rule, and a standalone LIF spikes the fc1 output before fc2.

name: Hybrid-MLP DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate rescales β, and an analog SiLU plus dropout sits between the two spiking MLP layers.

name: Neuron-only DeltaNet
summary: The q/k/v short convolutions lose their SiLU, so the spiking neurons are the only non-linearity in front of the delta rule; the rest is the expert block.

name: Regularised Neuron-only DeltaNet
summary: The neuron-only DeltaNet (short convolutions without SiLU) plus a loss of 0.001 times the mean firing rate of all block spikes.

name: SMSI DeltaNet
summary: The firing rate of a spiking copy of the normed input rescales that input before the q/k/v/β projections, and the key spike rate rescales β.

name: Spiking Gated S4D
summary: The S4D input is scaled by σ of a spiking projection of the normalised input, and a new spiking MLP is scaled by σ of a spiking projection of the un-normalised stream.

name: Multi-Feature Gating
summary: Mean / std / max statistics of spike tensors gate the SSD decay step dt, each sub-layer residual, and the whole block output.

name: Regulated Hybrid DeltaNet
summary: Same block as Out-rate-gated DeltaNet (key-rate β, o-rate output gate, GELU MLP) plus a loss on the mean firing rate of all block spikes.

name: All-spike-input DeltaNet
summary: Standalone LIF neurons spike the normed input of both sub-layers, and post-conv LIF neurons feed binary q/k/v spikes into the delta rule.

name: Hierarchical Adaptive Thresholds
summary: A spiking projection of x shifts a block-wide threshold that every branch builds on; the S4D input gets a spiking sigmoid gain, and FFN spikes are summed and re-spiked before gating.

name: Refined ADPT
summary: A sequence-mean of the input sets one global threshold per channel that divides every branch input; the FFN ANDs two spike trains and residuals become spike forget/update gates.

name: Spike Gain Gate
summary: The block's mean spike rate drives a one-bit neuron whose spike scales the MLP output by 1 + γ before the residual add.

name: Regularised Key-rate DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate rescales the delta-rule write strength β, an analog GELU sits between the MLP layers, and a loss on the mean firing rate keeps the block sparse.

name: Block-regularised DeltaNet
summary: The spiking DeltaNet block is unchanged; the only evolution is a loss of 0.01 times the mean firing rate over every spike tensor of the block, MLP spikes included.

name: Self-gated Residual DeltaNet
summary: Each sub-layer output gates itself through its own spiking linear before the residual add, on top of the SMSI input gain and the key-rate β of SMSI DeltaNet.

name: Neuron-centric DeltaNet
summary: The neuron-only DeltaNet (short convolutions without SiLU) plus a loss that adds 0.01 times the mean firing rate of every spike site separately.

name: Global-State Comba
summary: Adds a spiking global-context path that rescales the final recurrent state (cache only), on top of dual decay gates and spike encoders.

name: Target-rate DeltaNet
summary: The spiking DeltaNet block is unchanged; a loss 0.01·(r̄ − 0.05)² pulls the mean firing rate of all 7 spike sites towards a 5 % target instead of just pushing it down.

name: Adaptive-Gating DeltaNet
summary: Spike rates steer the whole block: an input spike rate scales the mixer input, the query rate scales β, sequence-level output rates gate both residual branches, and the attention-output rate rescales the stream before the MLP.

name: Binary spike-gated DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate scales β, and each sub-layer output is multiplied by 1 + a·s_t, where s_t is a single binary spike fired by a LIF neuron on that sub-layer's spike rate.

name: Learnable-range HomeoResSSM
summary: HomeoResSSM whose residual-gate range 1 + ρ·σ(g) has a learnable ρ instead of the fixed range (1, 3).

name: B/C-GELU HomeoResSSM
summary: HomeoResSSM plus an analog GELU on the B and C slices (the SSD keys and queries) before the scan.

name: Spike-aware β DeltaNet
summary: The β projection sees the input concatenated with the per-token firing rates of the q, k and v spike trains, the short convolutions lose their SiLU, and a loss on the mean firing rate keeps the block sparse.

name: Query-spike β DeltaNet
summary: The β projection reads the binary query spike train instead of the normed input, the short convolutions lose their SiLU, and a loss on the mean firing rate keeps the block sparse.

name: GLU-MLP Comba
summary: The MLP becomes a GLU: GELU of one spiking projection is gated by σ of a parallel spiking projection.

name: Refined β-Modulation DeltaNet
summary: Same as Regulated Hybrid DeltaNet (o-rate output gate, GELU MLP, spike-rate loss) except that the key spike rate scales β by 2σ(·) instead of 1 + tanh(·).

name: HSTA
summary: A multi-scale spike context sets dynamic thresholds and FFN branch weights; residuals become spike forget/update gates.

name: GELU-free Out-rate DeltaNet
summary: Like Refined β-Modulation DeltaNet (key-rate 2σ β, o-rate output gate, spike-rate loss) but with the GELU removed, so the MLP is two plain spiking linears.

name: Tanh-free Spiking Comba
summary: Spike encoders on every linear input, and a tanh-free spiking feedback net whose unbounded output shifts the decay.

name: Gated MLP + SS4D
summary: The S4D input is scaled by σ of a spiking projection of the normalised input, and a new spiking MLP is scaled by σ of a spiking projection of its own normalised input.

name: Spike-gated Residual LightNet
summary: Each sub-layer output is scaled channel-wise by a gate computed from that sub-layer's own per-token spike rate; the MLP uses an intermediate LIF instead of GELU.

name: Pre-spiked LightNet
summary: An explicit LIF layer turns each pre-norm output into binary spikes before the LightNet mixer and the deep-spiking MLP.

name: Rate-regularised HomeoResSSM
summary: HomeoResSSM plus a block-level firing-rate penalty on all of its spikes.

name: Spiking-Readout S4D
summary: The S4D output is read out by two spiking linear layers (d → 2d → d) instead of LIF → Conv1×1·GLU, with a spike-rate penalty.

name: Spike-Masked Feature Gating
summary: Before the S4D and before a new spiking MLP, a spiking projection of the normalised input is masked channel-wise by the binary spikes of a parallel neuron on the same input.

name: Spike-modulated Residual GSA
summary: Short convolutions run on spike trains, and each residual branch is rescaled by a tiny spiking MLP driven by that sub-layer's mean firing rate.

name: Spiking Co-Activation Unit
summary: One spiking projection emits an S4D input mask and the residual forget/update spikes; the FFN mixes its two spike trains through a learned spiking co-activation layer and gates its own residual.

name: Temporal Spike Gating
summary: Per-token spike rates, smoothed over time by a tiny causal conv, drive spiking gates s·σ(g) on both residual branches; the key spike rate also rescales β.

name: Spike-Input Gated SS4D
summary: The S4D input is masked by binary gate spikes and converted to spikes before the long convolution; a 2-layer spiking head replaces the GLU, and the FFN ANDs two spike trains.

name: Spike-gated MLP DeltaNet
summary: The key spike rate scales β by 2σ(·), and the fc1 input spike rate drives a spiking gate that scales the MLP output by 0.5 + 2σ(g); there is no o-rate gate and no spike-rate loss.

name: Tanh Spike-gated DeltaNet
summary: Per-token spike rates drive spiking gates that scale both residual branches by 1 + s·tanh(g) (no temporal smoothing); the key spike rate also rescales β.

name: Self-masked MLP LightNet
summary: The spiking LightNet token mixer is unchanged; in the MLP, fc1's analog output drives a standalone neuron whose spikes mask that same output (no GELU) before fc2.

name: Robust-Gating GSA
summary: The expert spiking GSA block, with each residual branch multiplied by a sigmoid gate computed from the branch itself through a short conv and a spiking projection.

name: LoopMem
summary: Feeds a normalized summary of its recurrent state back to the forget gate (state-norm feedback) and adds penalties on the mean spike activity of its token-mixing and channel-mixing branches to the training loss.

name: Multi-scale Gated GSA
summary: Each sub-layer output is scaled by a spiking gate that reads the branch through two parallel causal convolutions (k = 3, 5) before the residual add.

name: Adaptive Gated SSM
summary: Before the S4D and the MLP, input statistics set an adaptive scale and the spike rate of the scaled input (with causal temporal features) sets a sigmoid gate; the MLP gate also sees the S4D gate.

name: Q·K-rate DeltaNet
summary: The q and k spike rates jointly rescale β, spike-rate gates scale both residual branches by 1 + s·tanh(g), and a firing-rate loss keeps activity sparse.

name: Spike-gated Residual KDA
summary: Each residual branch is scaled per token by one scalar sigmoid gate from a spiking projection of the un-normalised sub-layer input; the MLP drops its GELU.

name: Spiking-MLP S4D
summary: Spiking S4 whose LIF + Conv1×1·GLU readout is replaced by a two-layer spiking MLP, with a firing-rate penalty.

name: Spike-modulated FFN
summary: The q/k/v spike rates jointly rescale β, and the fc1/fc2 spike rates drive a spiking sigmoid gate on the MLP output.

name: Spike-Direct MLP Comba
summary: LoopMem's block with the GELU removed from the spiking MLP, so fc2's neuron is the only nonlinearity between the two projections.

name: Spike-masked Gated-residual S4D
summary: Spiking S4 whose output is masked by input spikes and read out by a spiking MLP; the residual becomes a spiking forget/input gate.

name: Sigmoid-gated S4D + FFN
summary: Spiking S4 whose input is scaled by a spike-driven sigmoid gate, followed by a new spiking FFN sub-layer whose output is scaled the same way.

name: Two-rate MLP Gate DeltaNet
summary: The q and k spike rates jointly rescale β; spike-rate gates scale both residual branches by 1 + s·tanh(g), the MLP gate reading fc1 and fc2 rates as two separate inputs.

name: Decoupled Spike Gating
summary: The q/k/v spike rates rescale β and the fc1/fc2 spike rates drive a sigmoid gate on the MLP output (as in Spike-modulated FFN), here with a 0.01 · mean firing-rate loss added.

name: Adaptive MLP Gate
summary: The q/k/v spike rates rescale β, and the spike rates of all token-mixer neurons drive a feature-wise spiking gate on the MLP hidden layer.

name: RMSNorm Spiking-MLP S4D
summary: Spiking S4 with a two-layer spiking-MLP readout instead of LIF + Conv1×1·GLU, RMSNorm pre-norm and a firing-rate penalty.

name: Regularised GELU-MLP DeltaNet
summary: The expert spiking DeltaNet mixer is kept; the MLP gains an analog GELU between fc1 and fc2 (as in GELU-MLP DeltaNet), and a 0.01 · mean firing-rate loss is added.

name: Spike-masked FFN S4D
summary: Spiking S4 with a spike-driven sigmoid input gate, plus a spiking FFN whose input is masked by binary gate spikes and a target-rate loss.

name: Explicit Spike Gating
summary: Spike rates of q and k rescale β and the decay, new spiking accumulate/forget gates control the state write, LIF spikes boost both sub-layer outputs and the GELU, and the expert SiLU output gate is dropped.

name: Spike Router
summary: Three parallel branches (GSA, S4D, MLP) are each scaled by spikes from their own router projection and summed.

name: Head-rate-gated DeltaNet
summary: Spike rates replace analog inputs for control: the k-spike rate sets β, and per-head and MLP spike rates gate each branch before the residual add.

name: Hybrid Gated Residual
summary: Each residual add becomes x + y⊙scale + shift, with scale and shift from spiking projections of the residual boosted by their own firing rate; β comes from the k-spike rate.

name: Output Spike-gated S4D
summary: Spiking S4 with a spiking-MLP readout whose branch output is multiplied by binary spikes from the normalised input before the residual add.

name: Post-GELU Spike-Mask LightNet
summary: The spiking LightNet token mixer is unchanged; in the MLP a standalone neuron fires on the GELU output and its binary spikes mask that output before fc2.

name: Regularised Key-rate β DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the k spike train rescales the delta-rule write strength β by a factor in (0, 2), a 0.01 · mean spike-rate loss is added, and block dropout is removed.

name: Spike-gated-v DeltaNet
summary: Spike rates drive three gates: the v-spike rate scales the values per head, the k-spike rate rescales β, and the fc1 spike rate rescales the MLP output.

name: Split-Reg Comba
summary: Same block as LoopMem: spiking Comba with state-norm feedback plus separate spike-rate penalties for the mixer and the MLP.

name: Dormant-gate Key-rate DeltaNet
summary: The mean firing rate of the k spike train rescales the delta-rule write strength β by a factor in (0, 2); the v-rate output gate named in the rationale is coded but never runs (use_gate=False), and no spike-rate loss is used.

name: Contextual Spike-Activity Gate
summary: A norm-capped delta-rule state, a sigmoid-gated direct value path fused with the recurrent read-out, and residual branches scaled by gates driven by their own spike rates.

name: Dual-Gated MLP LightNet
summary: The spiking LightNet token mixer is unchanged; the MLP hidden state is masked twice by binary spikes of two standalone neurons, before and after GELU.

name: Dynamic-β Reg DeltaNet
summary: Same computation as Regularised Key-rate β DeltaNet (only cosmetic code changes): the k-spike rate rescales β by a factor in (0, 2), with a 0.01 · mean spike-rate loss and no dropout.

name: Holistic Gating DeltaNet
summary: q/k spike rates rescale β, the k-spike rate gates the token-mixer output, a block-wide mean of k, fc1 and fc2 spike rates gates the MLP output, and an analog GELU sits between fc1 and fc2.

name: Generalized-Reg Comba
summary: Spiking Comba with state-norm feedback; one spike-rate penalty is taken over all seven spiking sites of the block.

name: NeuroGate
summary: The mean firing rate of the q/k/v spike trains rescales the delta-rule write strength β.

name: Simplified SNN Comba
summary: Functionally identical to the spiking Comba expert (closed-loop decay, spiking MLP with GELU); the evolved step only removed the spike-rate loss.

name: Adaptive Reg DeltaNet
summary: The β projection also sees the q/k/v spike rates of the token, and a target-rate loss pulls the block's mean firing towards 10 %.

name: Clamped Rate-gated DeltaNet
summary: The k-spike rate sets β, per-head and MLP spike rates amplify each branch by 1 + g·σ(·) before the residual add, the delta-rule state is clamped to ±10, and an analog GELU sits between fc1 and fc2.

name: Light-Reg Comba
summary: Spiking Comba with state-norm feedback and one pooled spike-rate penalty (λ = 0.001) over all spiking sites.

name: Adaptive MLP Bias
summary: The token's q/k/v spike rates from the token mixer drive a spiking linear whose output is added as a bias to the MLP input.

name: Light-Reg Comba V3
summary: Spiking Comba with state-norm feedback and one pooled spike-rate penalty (λ = 0.001); the other changes are masking and caching code.

name: Binary-gated DeltaProduct
summary: Short convolutions run on spikes, β, decay and the output gate become binary spikes, and each residual branch is switched channel-wise by spikes computed from the residual stream.

name: Spike-regularised GSA
summary: The expert spiking GSA block, unchanged except for a block-level loss on the mean firing rate of all eight spiking sites.

name: Spike Feature-gated GSA
summary: A spiking feature gate modulates the GSA input, and both residual adds become spike-gated merges x⊙(1−f) + b⊙a.

name: Regulated Spiking DeltaNet
summary: The expert Spiking DeltaNet block is unchanged; the only evolution is a 0.001 · mean firing-rate loss over all its spike trains, now including the MLP spikes.

name: GELU-free Spiking GSA
summary: The expert spiking GSA block with the GELU removed between the two spiking MLP layers, plus a block-level loss on the mean firing rate.

name: GSFFN Comba
summary: Learnable per-channel gains scale the input of every spiking neuron, the state feedback is a single linear map, and the MLP becomes a gated spiking FFN.

name: Self-read Context-gated SSM
summary: Residual gates driven by the normed sub-layer input through tiny spiking MLPs, an SSD read-out that includes the current token's write, no GELU, and a light firing-rate penalty.

name: Spiking-D S4D
summary: Spiking-read-out S4D in which the diagonal skip D·u is replaced by a spiking full-matrix D projection; penalty on the squared rate.

name: Sparse-rate Comba
summary: Spiking Comba with a GELU-free spiking MLP and a squared mean-firing-rate penalty that pushes all 7 spiking sites toward sparsity.

name: Sparse-activation SSM
summary: Residual gates driven by the normed sub-layer input through tiny spiking MLPs, all GELUs removed, a strictly causal SSD read-out and a light firing-rate penalty.

name: Target-rate Comba
summary: Spiking Comba with a GELU-free spiking MLP and a homeostatic loss that holds the block's mean firing rate near 5 %.

name: Multi-scale Spike-conv Gating
summary: Spike trains are filtered by weighted multi-scale causal convolutions to gate the S4D input and a new spiking FFN, whose gate is also driven by the S4D's own spikes.
